name: meeting-notes
description: Read-only access to the meetings recorded by the Meeting Notes app: list, search and read notes and transcripts.
long_description: Lets Claude look up your meetings from the Meeting Notes Mac app. It reads meta.json, notes.md and transcript.md in your meetings folder (the one set in the app's Settings), never audio files, and can't change or delete anything.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List recorded meetings, newest first, with id, title, date, duration, status and call app.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Case-insensitive text search across meeting titles, notes and transcripts, with snippets.

tools.name: get_notes
tools.description: The meeting notes (summary, decisions, action items, open questions, key points) for a meeting.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The full timestamped transcript for a meeting.
